Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.101 of 2023 at Police Station-Tharwai, District- Prayagraj under Sections 376, 354, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 06.07.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 25.08.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Nitin Sharma, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Roopchandra @ Gole vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55069182/

sentences.text: 1. Delay in taking out proceedings under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and consequent lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts and circumstances of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The F.I.R. arises out of a family dispute over a joint property.
3. The applicant is a brother-in-law of the victim.
4. The criminal proceedings are being leveraged to force the applicant to settle the property dispute on terms of the victim and her husband.
5. The medical examination was got conducted six months after the incident and cannot be related to the incident nor does it not depict commission of rape by the applicant.

6. No incriminating articles like torn clothes and broken bangles, etc. have been recovered.
7. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Roopchandra @ Gole be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Dhananjai  Roopchandra @ Gole vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55069182/
